data.text:
A fire broke out in a residential area near the vicinity of Aroma Compound along Road 10 in Barangay 105, Tondo, Manila on Wednesday, August 6.

According to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), the blaze escalated quickly and reached Task Force Charlie status as of 10:59 a.m.

Manila Mayor Isko Moreno immediately proceeded to the scene to personally assess the situation, oversee evacuation efforts, and ensure that affected residents receive immediate assistance.

📷: John Louie Abrina | MB

[6:05AM] #IkoroduRd
#TrafficUpdate

We are still having rapid movement coming from Ketu inward Ojota down to Anthony on both the service lane and the main carriage way, though Ojota bus stop is expected to be busier as influx and bus stop activities increase.

Anthony en route Onipan, Fadeyi and Dormanlong bridge to connect Funso Williams Avenue is also looking good for now.

On that return journey, the entire stretch from Dormanlong bridge back to Ojota and Ketu is very free.
Please drive responsibly.

[6:32AM] #LagBadagryExpWay
#TrafficUpdate

We are having it good around Badagry roundabout inward and outward. Movement from Badagry roundabout through Ibereko axis, Aradagun, Mosafejo, Mowo, enroute Oko Afo through Magbon, Ibiye, Church gate, down to Ajibade is good(Inward and outward). 

Movement from Ajibade through Morogbo junction down to Agbara Custom Check Point is slow due to high influx moving inward Ijanikin and market activities around the corridor.  

The return journey from Agbara Custom Check Point through Agbara Estate gate down to Ajibade is good.
